solution_summary: Unifies 25,000+ students, faculty, and staff on a secure, FERPA-compliant Workspace environment University of California, Riverside is a global engine for social mobility, helping students from all backgrounds move into high-earning careers. Ranked in the top 1.3% of universities worldwide, UCR empowers over 25,000+ students and faculty in southern California to turn bold ideas into global solutions. However, even for a national leader in innovation, fragmented legacy technologies often created administrative friction, slowing essential processes like IT support and course scheduling. Operating with a leaner staffing model than its peers, UCR needed a way to maximize its workforce’s impact without sacrificing the high-touch, personal campus experience that defines its mission.
